## ⚖️ MANDATORY Religious & Theological Boundaries (AGENTS.md)

*Every contributor must confirm compliance with the foundational editorial boundaries:*

- [ ] **Zero Hallucination**: No Quranic Arabic text was generated, modified, or paraphrased by an AI. All Arabic text matches verified Medina Mushaf (Uthmani script).
- [ ] **No Invented Citations**: All Hadith, Tafsir (exegesis), and scholar citations are verified and attributed to authentic sources with scholar name and century.
- [ ] **Strict 4-Level Content Hierarchy Maintained**:
  - Level 1: Original Verified Quranic Arabic (Uthmani script)
  - Level 2: Attributed Human Translations (Saheeh, Bernström, Hamidullah, etc.)
  - Level 3: Classical Tafsir (Ibn Kathir, Al-Sa'di, Al-Muyassar, etc.)
  - Level 4: AI Synthesis / Reflection Prompts (Clearly tagged as AI / contemplation)
- [ ] **Non-Fatwa Stance**: Hidaya remains a guide to sources, never issuing legal verdicts, life commands, or fatwas.
- [ ] **Privacy Guarantees**: Raw user narratives and situation descriptions are NOT logged to any remote database.

## ✅ Quality & Testing Checklist

- [ ] Code passes `npm run typecheck` with **0 errors**.
- [ ] Code passes `npm run lint` with **0 errors**.
- [ ] Production build succeeds via `npm run build`.
- [ ] Tested locally across screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop).
- [ ] High contrast and dark mode compatibility verified.
- [ ] State tracking in `docs/STATE.md` updated if this milestone introduces a new capability.
